gloss_en: the breaking-down and nullification through speech (mitmalel u-mishtaber) of the bonfire-fire of the seventy stars — i.e., the Holy Tongue's power to 'speak down' and shatter the fire of the seventy nations' languages/celestial powers (the 'mal' of Chashmal, in Likutey Moharan I:19)
canonical_he: מתמלל ומשתבר אש המדורה של שבעין כוכבין
